items.title: Phil Mead interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, June 1, 2006
items.q: my dad would occasionally take me down to New York to Eddie Condon’s. He was a great Condon fan and I became a great Condon fan.

ctx.x: It was a bit of a compromise on his part but a good one.

A good one. Although he didn’t last that long in high school music. In any event, so that’s about the time that I decided I wanted to go to Hamilton College. And I heard — great they had a Dixieland band. And I’d been listening. I was kind of brought up as a swing player but I’d been listening to Dixieland and my dad would occasionally take me down to New York to Eddie Condon’s. He was a great Condon fan and I became a great Condon fan. So I heard they had a Dixieland band at Hamilton and the leader was a guy…
